object.name: base
object.prompt: A single ancient magical fire rune for a dark fantasy 2D side-scrolling pixel art RPG. A small, solid dark volcanic basalt stone tablet with a distinctive flame-shaped symbol carved into its center. The symbol glows with intense molten orange and golden-yellow light, with subtle magma cracks spreading through the dark stone surface. Ancient mystical design, sharp angular edges, volcanic atmosphere, powerful but readable silhouette. Front-facing game object, centered composition, designed to fit a 64x64 pixel sprite. Crisp pixel art, consistent pixel scale, clearly defined individual pixels, limited color palette, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients. Transparent background. One rune only, no characters, no text, no UI, no additional objects.

rows.animation: Animate this existing volcanic rune for a dark fan
